Resolves #20980

`applyCellSelection` now records the classes it added beside the ones it wanted, so a deselect withdraws only what the model put on the node. A cell that carried `neo-selected` before its selection keeps the class, a class `getCellCls()` stops returning still leaves, and an unchanged answer still returns `false` without touching the row.

Evidence: local L (Node-only unit harness, `unit/grid` + `unit/selection`, 507 passed) → L required (CI unit run; AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-5). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 direct node keeps a pre-existing `neo-selected` across the deselect | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/grid/CellSelectionKeepsForeignCls.spec.mjs` (`applyCellSelection withdraws only its own classes`) |
| AC-2 a rule deselect leaves the `selectedColumns` fallback class painted by `grid.Row` | CI-covered: same spec (`A rule that clears over a column-selected cell`) |
| AC-3 an unchanged answer returns `false` | CI-covered: same spec, asserted on the second direct call |
| AC-4 `#cellCls` JSDoc and the method summary stay true | Source: `#cellCls` now names both the added and the wanted classes; the summary is unchanged and holds |
| AC-5 `unit/grid` + `unit/selection` green | Local: `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/grid test/playwright/unit/selection` → 507 passed (CI re-runs) |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. `#cellCls` stores `{added, cls}` as the ticket proposed; the early return compares `applied.cls`, and the remove receives `applied.added`. Both arms were red on `dev` before the change and the repaint arm of `CellSelectionByRule.spec.mjs` stays green.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**: Two non-blocking edge notes verified while tracing `BaseModel.mjs` + `Row.mjs`:
  1. **Interleaved dynamic `updateColumns` without `selectedColumnCellCls`:** `#cellCls` snapshots `added` when `applyCellSelection` paints the cell. If a model without a distinct `selectedColumnCellCls` (falling back to `'neo-selected'` in `BaseModel#updateColumns` at `:736`) selects a cell *first* (`added: ['neo-selected']`) and *then* adds its column via `updateColumns` before deselecting the cell, `applyCellSelection` will still withdraw `'neo-selected'` (and conversely `updateColumns` deselection toggles `'neo-selected'` unconditionally). Ticket #20980 explicitly scopes out `grid.Row`'s `'neo-selected'` column fallback, and shipped `CellColumnModel` / `CellColumnRowModel` set a distinct `selectedColumnCellCls: 'selected-column-cell'`, so no change is needed here.
  2. **Test polish note (`CellSelectionKeepsForeignCls.spec.mjs`):** In the first `test()` (`:121`), `const model = Neo.create(DirectModel, {})` is not paired with `model.destroy()` (harmless here since it is viewless and isolated to the spec worker), and the second `test()` asserts `'col2'` keeps `'neo-selected'` while relying on `CellSelectionByRule.spec.mjs:246` to cover `'col3'` losing `'neo-selected'`.
